# Best waterproof Bluetooth speakers for the pool or beach

**Best overall: JBL Charge 6 (about $130-$150)**
- It has an IP68 rating, 20 hours of battery (28 with Playtime Boost), and a rugged build. It can also charge your phone. What Hi-Fi? named it the best waterproof speaker overall, and Best Products picked it too.
- Prices listed: $129.99 at Walmart, $149.95 at Amazon.
- [Buy links and review (What Hi-Fi?)](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)

**Best for pool parties: JBL Boombox 4**
- It's RTINGS' top waterproof pick. It's built for long immersion, it floats, and the battery lasts over 40 hours. Sound is loud and balanced, though it's directional, so it sounds muffled if you're beside or behind it. It's big and pricey.
- [Prices and review (RTINGS)](https://www.rtings.com/speaker/reviews/best/by-type/waterproof-bluetooth)

**Best 360° sound: Ultimate Ears Epicboom**
- Tom's Guide's best overall pick. It's IP67, floats, and sounds the same from any seat. Battery is about 15 hours, and it costs less than the Boombox 4.
- [Buy links (Tom's Guide)](https://www.tomsguide.com/best-picks/best-waterproof-speakers)

**Best budget: Ultimate Ears Wonderboom 4 (about $65-$76)**
- It's softball-sized, IP67, and floats. It gets 14 hours of battery and has big 360° sound for its size. It isn't as loud as the larger speakers.
- [Buy links (Best Products)](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g938/best-waterproof-bluetooth-speakers/)

**Best for packing light**
- **JBL Grip (about $100):** Good Housekeeping's best overall. It's IP68, can-sized, and under a pound, with 12 hours of battery. The mesh body collects dust. [Buy link](https://www.goodhousekeeping.com/what-to-buy/a71783745/best-waterproof-speakers/)
- **JBL Go 5 (about $40):** It's IP67 and tiny, with up to 8 hours of battery. It's the cheapest good option here. [Buy link](https://www.whathifi.com/best-buys/best-waterproof-speakers-around-right-now-budget-portable-smart)

**Big, loud, and floats: Soundcore Boom 2 Plus**
- It's 100 W, IPX7, floats, and gets up to 20 hours of battery. It weighs 3.8 kg. Soundcore's list price is $249.99, and code AFSC20 brings it to about $200. The site says it tested the code on Oct 22, but checkout has the final word. It has no dust rating, so keep it on a towel at the beach. [Soundcore deal page](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-boom-2-plus)

## Quick pick
- **One speaker for everything:** JBL Charge 6
- **Floating pool-party speaker:** JBL Boombox 4, or the Epicboom if you want to spend less
- **Cheap and easy to carry:** Wonderboom 4, or Go 5 for the lowest price

## Care tips
IP ratings don't cover salt or chlorine damage. RTINGS recommends rinsing the speaker with fresh water after use, and checking your manual first. Close the charging-port flap before exposure, and let the speaker dry completely before charging. Sand is the bigger beach risk, so keep it on a towel rather than burying it.
